arabic text: AY QATILE SHABBIR TU KYA KAAT RAHA HAI\nDAR ASL PAYAMBAR KA GALA KAAT RAHA HAI
english translation text: O killer of Shabbir, what are you cutting?\nIn truth, you are cutting the Prophet’s throat.

arabic text: JAARI HAI LABE SHAAH PE - TASBEEHE ILAAHI\nSHEH RAG NAHI TU ZIKR E - KHUDA KAAT RAHA HAI
english translation text: Divine praise continues upon the Master’s lips.\nYou are not cutting a vein—you are cutting the remembrance of God.

arabic text: RAAHO ME KISI SHAKHS NE - SAJJAD SE POOCHA\nKYA JURM HAI KYU SAKHT - SAZA KAAT RAHA HAI
english translation text: On the road, someone asked Sajjad:\nWhat crime have you committed that you endure such punishment?

arabic text: KAANO ME SAKINA KE - HAI RET KE ZARRE\nHAR ZARRA HI KAATE KI -TARAH KAAT RAHA HAI
english translation text: Grains of sand are lodged in Sakina’s ears;\neach grain cuts her like a thorn.

arabic text: NAIZE KI ANI CHADAR E ZAINAB ME ALI HAI\nNAIZA SARE ZAINAB KI - RIDA KAAT RAHA HAI
english translation text: Ali is present in the point of the spear that tears Zainab’s veil.\nThat spear is cutting away the covering from Zainab’s head.
